parsed.explanation: The dossier documents active, state-driven targeting: a fresh penal code criminalising same-sex conduct with 2–5 years' imprisonment, drafted by birth-assigned sex so trans visitors fall squarely inside it, plus an undefined 'promotion' offence; a prior enforcement record using indecency and morality laws against gender-nonconforming expression; and since December 2024 a reported increase in arbitrary arrests and physical abuse based on appearance alone. A military junta frames this as moral defence; the justice minister openly hostile; no anti-discrimination recourse, no protective body, no documented relief. Per rule 13 this resolves toward the structural risk: state-tolerated targeting (tier 2), enforcement current, remedy absent. Absent documented torture/executions or sweeps reaching near-certain imprisonment for visitors, this sits at high rather than severe risk, near the 0.25 anchors.
